mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of GDPC1 YoY decline exceeding 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately compressing profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of UNRATE > 4% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month and < previous month - 0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of three consecutive months of INDPRO declines exceeding 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST over two consecutive months indicates weakening housing and overall demand, which depresses consumer spending and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in FEDFUNDS and a decrease in RSAFS (reserves) over a quarter signals a tightening of monetary policy and reduced liquidity, which increases risk premia and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and RSAFS falls in the same quarter
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises and RSAFS falls in the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-month moving average for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A positive year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL above 4% combined with a flat or declining GDPC1 indicates high inflation with stagnant growth, which erodes real corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of CPIAUCSL YoY > 4% and GDPC1 YoY <= 0%.
